artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures rising from the ground. The drawing depicts multiple human figures emerging from a mass of bones and earth. The central figure, with long flowing hair and beard, is kneeling and seems to be addressing the sky, where rays of light descend from the clouds. The other figures around him are in various poses of ascent and movement. The scene is detailed with intricate use of lines to create texture and depth. The sky is filled with clouds.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient mythological scene. The image shows an outdoor setting with two older men and a female figure seated. One man is standing and holding a goblet with a face design engraved on it, while the other man gestures towards a columned structure at the center. The background includes architectural elements, arches, and ornate topiary in a terraced garden. In the distance, there is a group of figures near a city skyline. The drawing features detailed line work and a classic style inspired by mythological and historical themes.

artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people engaged in an act of charity. The image presents a collection of individuals in various poses, with detailed clothing and expressions. The background includes architectural elements suggesting an urban setting.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. It depicts armored figures engaged in combat. The central figure is dynamic and muscular, wielding a shield and sword, fighting other warriors amidst fallen soldiers. The background features clouds and mountains, creating depth. The composition is detailed and linear, conveying intense struggle and movement.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of knights among trees with some human figures depicted as hanged. The scene is set in a forested area where armored figures are scattered throughout. The foreground shows a large tree, and several figures, some in armor, are positioned around it. Some wear full armor while others have helmets and chainmail. Among the group of figures, some are bound and appear to be prisoners. Several figures are depicted hanging from tree branches. The image features detailed line work, conveying texture and depth in the foliage and the figures' armor. The trees are illustrated with gnarled bark.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight battling a dragon. The scene depicts a knight in armor on horseback fighting a dragon. The detailed lines show the intensity of the battle. The background features rocky terrain and foliage, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chariot with horses. The work showcases intricately detailed line work typical of woodcut prints. The scene features a chariot pulled by two spirited horses, adorned with elaborate harnesses. The background shows a wooded landscape with architecture outlines, possibly indicating a town or fortification. The figures interact with the chariot and convey a dynamic scene. The artwork demonstrates a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail common in Renaissance prints.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting. The image depicts figures in varying positions, with different gestures and interactions among them. The background includes architectural elements that suggest a city scene. The drawing features strong lines and hatching, typical of woodcut or engraving techniques.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a historical setting. The scene depicts several individuals in elaborate garments and armor gathered around a seated figure who appears to be holding a scroll or document. The setting suggests an important event or council meeting in a classical or medieval context, with architectural elements like columns and drapery adding to the grandeur. The scene is rich in detail, capturing the texture of fabrics and the intricacies of the armor worn. Shadows and fine lines have been used to indicate depth and volume. The composition and style bear the hallmarks of Renaissance woodcut art.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This image shows a forest scene where a person is lying on the ground near a tree and another individual is approaching them. A horse is tethered to a tree in the background, and there are other figures present. The drawing features detailed cross-hatching and strong contrast, creating a sense of depth. The trees are tall and dense, contributing to a gloomy atmosphere, enhanced by a monochrome, textured style reminiscent of early woodcuts or etchings.

artworks.title: The Paralytic Healed by Christ Picks up His Pallet
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals gathered in an outdoor setting with a notable scene unfolding. The image features intricate line work typical of woodcut prints, depicting various figures in robes and hats. The figures have solemn postures and interactions. One central figure stands with a halo-like aura around the head, drawing focus amidst others engaged in dialogue or a communal gathering. The background includes architectural elements like pillars and structures, adding depth to the scene. The style is reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer, known for similar works during the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures inside an architectural setting. The central figure, an elderly man with a beard, is gesturing dramatically. Surrounding him are other figures in various seated and standing positions. The figures wear elaborate period clothing, and the background includes an arched doorway revealing more figures and structures. A dog is also depicted in the scene. The drawing style resembles a detailed woodcut or engraving, using fine lines and shading to show texture and depth.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of individuals in distress within an architectural setting. The drawing includes detailed line hatching and cross-hatching, emphasizing clothing folds, architectural elements, and expressions on faces. The background features classical arches and columns. Two figures are helping another, while a fourth figure stands apart. Shadows and highlights are used to create volume and space, typical of a woodcut or engraving.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of robed figures gathered around a table in an architectural setting. The figures are dressed in flowing robes and holding staffs or long objects, engaging in an activity in the center of the room. The background features arches, a column, and a grid-like pattern on the windows, creating depth in the space. The lines are crisp and include crosshatching to show shadows and depth.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals engaging in a narrative scene with architectural elements in the background. The drawing is rendered in black and white with a rich use of line and texture to convey detail and depth. The central focus appears to be on interaction and movement, with characters wearing period attire. The scene is composed with a balance of light and shadow, enhancing the drama of the visual story.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an animated scene featuring multiple figures dressed in historical or medieval attire. The figures are gathered around a central middle figure, who appears to be in motion or distress. The scene is set against an architectural backdrop with arches and elevated structures. The characters are detailed with textured fabrics and hair, and the drawing includes sharp lines and shading for depth and detail.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection)

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical beast with multiple heads confronting a group of figures. The image features a creature with seven heads, each crowned, and a body that appears to be a blend of various animals, standing aggressively with multiple serpentine necks. The background depicts rocky formations and a sunburst-like design at the top of the composition. The group of figures on the left are arranged closely, with expressions of surprise or curiosity, dressed in medieval-style robes and garments. The contrast of light and shadow is created by fine lines and hatching, typical of engravings or woodcut artwork, adding a dramatic and intense atmosphere. The setting suggests an allegorical or mythological scene.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with angelic figures. The image shows several armored angelic beings engaging in combat. Some are wielding swords and shields, while one is subduing another figure. Above them, an angel holds a trumpet surrounded by clouds. On the right side, a crowned figure watches over the scene from a raised platform. The drawing is full of movement and energy, with swirling clouds and muscular figures. The linework and shading emphasize tension and dramatic action.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged creature engaging in a struggle with a figure in flowing robes. The scene is set against a dynamic landscape with swirling clouds overhead and a cityscape in the background. Other figures are also present in the drawing. The line work and shading are detailed and intricate.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a robed figure writing in a book while an ethereal figure appears in the clouds above. The drawing depicts a seated figure with large feathered wings, dressed in flowing robes, holding a quill to a book or scroll resting on a rock. The scene is set amidst a dramatic landscape, with a mountainous background and a body of water behind the figure. To the left, the landscape features trees and shrubs, while to the right of the figure, there appears to be a mythical creature with wings. In the sky above, a smaller figure surrounded by radiant light is visible. The use of line work and shading is intricate.

artworks.title: The Waterfall and Town of Tivoli
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over black chalk, squared for transfer with red chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch of a town built on a rugged cliffside. The scene features closely clustered buildings with dark rooftops, an arched structure, and rolling hills in the background. The drawing style consists of loose brushstrokes and crosshatching in sepia and earthy tones, creating an impressionistic and dynamic look. The sketch displays architectural detail with quick brushwork, giving the scene a lively quality.

artworks.title: Ruins by a Woodland Stream
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a dense forest with an old stone structure among the trees, viewed from ground level. The canopy obscures the horizon, creating an intimate and enclosed atmosphere. The foliage and branches are intricately detailed, with the ruins shaded to show age and texture. Delicate brushstrokes capture the play of light and shadow on the trunks and leaves precisely. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of gray, creating a tranquil setting. Soft light filters through the trees, illuminating parts of the ruins and forest floor. Figures are engaged in quiet activity in the background.

artworks.title: Port of San Remo
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal scene from above eye level. The shoreline is visible with sailboats on the left. The horizon is low, with the sky dominating the top. In the distance to the right, there is a domed building. The intricate brushstrokes show texture, including ripples in the water and clouds in the sky. The color palette is black and off-white, emphasizing light and shadows. Faint outlines of buildings and ships are in the distance.
